description:
About our brand and products: Protecticoat is a clear protective coating that restores and protects faded outdoor surfaces, patio furniture, railings, RVs, boats, fences, and light fixtures. It revives color and seals against UV and weather. We also make OmniClean, a concentrate prep cleaner that gets surfaces ready for coating.

What makes us different: It is not a ceramic coating. Protecticoat is a clear acrylate polymer that penetrates and protects without yellowing, cracking, or peeling. The before-and-after is dramatic, which makes it a natural fit for short-form video.

How affiliates can earn: Earn 12% commission on every sale driven by your link or personal code, with a 30-day tracking window. Your audience also gets 10% off with your code. Commissions are paid every two weeks via PayPal.

How to promote us: Post real before-and-after content on outdoor surfaces, share your code in captions and your link in your bio. Great fit for outdoor-living, RV, boating, auto-detailing, home-improvement, and DIY creators.

Other information: US-based program, manual approval. Always disclose the partnership with #ad. Please never describe Protecticoat as a "ceramic coating."
payout_period: Commissions are paid every two weeks via PayPal, after your referral order is approved.

Protecticoat Creator & Affiliate Program: Terms and Policy

Effective date: {go-live date}Program operator: Protecticoat Last updated: June 8 2026

These terms govern participation in the Protecticoat Creator & Affiliate Program ("the Program"). By registering, you ("Affiliate" or "Creator") agree to the terms below. Protecticoat may update these terms; material changes will be communicated by email.

1. Eligibility and enrollment

Affiliates must apply through the official registration page and be approved by Protecticoat. Approval is at Protecticoat's discretion. You must be at least 18 years old and provide accurate account and payout information. Protecticoat may decline or remove any applicant or Affiliate at any time.

2. Commission

Approved Affiliates earn a commission on qualifying sales generated through their assigned tracked link or personal discount code, at the rate stated in their program (standard rate: 12%). Commission is calculated on the order value after any customer discount is applied, and excludes shipping, taxes, and any platform fees. Custom-rate agreements, where offered in writing, supersede the standard rate for that Affiliate.

3. Customer discount

Each Affiliate is issued a personal discount code that gives their audience 10% off. The code may not be altered, resold, or posted to coupon-aggregator or deal sites. Posting codes to coupon directories is grounds for removal and commission forfeiture. Protecticoat sets whether codes may combine with other promotions; codes may be restricted on already-discounted items.

4. FTC disclosure (required)

Affiliates must clearly and conspicuously disclose their material connection to Protecticoat in every post, video, story, or message that promotes the product. Acceptable disclosures include "#ad," "paid partnership," or a platform's built-in paid-partnership label, placed where the audience will see it before engaging. Disclosures buried in comments, hidden behind "more," or omitted entirely are not acceptable and may result in removal from the Program. Affiliates are responsible for complying with the FTC Endorsement Guides and the rules of each platform they use.

5. Product claims

Affiliates must represent Protecticoat accurately. Specifically:

  • Do not describe Protecticoat as a "ceramic coating" or use ceramic-tier language such as "9H." Protecticoat is a clear acrylate polymer coating.
  • Do not promise results Protecticoat has not stated, including specific durability figures beyond the published guidance.
  • Show the product on real, appropriate surfaces (for example wrought iron, pool loungers, railings, exterior lights, RVs, outdoor furniture).
  • Do not make health, safety, or environmental claims beyond the product's official labeling and SDS.

6. Prohibited promotion tactics

The following will result in withheld or reversed commissions and removal from the Program:

  • Bidding on Protecticoat brand terms or trademarks in paid search, or running ads that impersonate Protecticoat.
  • Self-referrals or using your own code for personal purchases for commission.
  • Spam, misleading claims, fake reviews, or incentivized clicks.
  • Coupon-site, cashback-site, or extension-based code distribution.
  • Cookie stuffing or any artificial inflation of clicks or orders.
  • Promotion on sites or channels with hateful, adult, illegal, or otherwise off-brand content.

7. Payouts

Commissions are paid monthly by PayPal (store credit available on request) once they clear a 30-day approval hold that covers the customer return window. A minimum balance of $25 is required to trigger a payout; balances below the minimum roll forward. Commissions on orders that are refunded, cancelled, charged back, or paid with an unauthorized or stacked discount will be reversed. Affiliates are responsible for any taxes owed on commissions earned.

8. Tracking and attribution

Sales are attributed by personal discount code and by tracked link within a 30-day cookie window from the click. Protecticoat's records and platform reporting are the final authority on attribution and commission amounts. Protecticoat is not liable for sales lost to a customer clearing cookies, using a different device, or removing the code at checkout.

9. Relationship and conduct

Affiliates are independent contractors, not employees, agents, or representatives of Protecticoat, and may not make commitments on Protecticoat's behalf. Affiliates may not speak for the brand, respond to warranty claims, or set pricing. All brand assets provided remain Protecticoat's property and may be used only to promote Protecticoat during active participation.

10. Term and termination

Either party may end participation at any time for any reason. On termination, the Affiliate's codes and links are deactivated and approved, cleared commissions are paid out on the next normal cycle. Protecticoat may withhold commissions tied to conduct that violates these terms. Sections covering product claims, prohibited tactics, payouts, and attribution survive termination.

11. Contact

Program questions: support@protecticoat.com

12. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates must not engage in fraudulent activities, spam, or misrepresent our products or services.

Sensitive Traffic Sources Policy:

Affiliates must not promote products through the following sensitive traffic sources without prior written approval:

  • Adult content websites or platforms
  • Illegal content or file-sharing sites
  • Sites promoting violence, hate speech, or discrimination
  • Gambling or betting platforms
  • Cryptocurrency or high-risk investment promotions
